correctness.rationale: Every maximal independent set I of S(G) is uniquely determined by U, the omitted original vertices: subdivision vertex s_uv is selected iff both u,v lie in U; every u in U is dominated iff G[U] has positive degree at u. Thus for all finite simple G the weight is |V|-|U|+|E(G[U])|. For K_ab nonempty admissible U meet both shores with sizes p,q and pq edges, giving the exact double binomial sum and its support a+b-1+(p-1)(q-1). The empty U term coincides with product 1 when a,b>=2; boundaries a=1 and n=2 are explicitly handled. Ford’s known multiplication-table order, not a new proof, yields sparse support; independent adjacency-based brute force checked five small bicliques including stars.

evidence: Babikir–Dettlaff–Henning–Lemańska define the independent-domination subdivision number: minimum count of *selected* edge subdivisions needed to raise a minimum invariant.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The operation of fully subdividing every edge and enumerating all maximal independent sets differs from optimizing the number of subdivided edges; no implication of full biclique polynomial follows from their theorem.
